reason: The teacher assigns it and checks it in class, and the diagnostic showed me exactly where she is behind, which ChatGPT and YouTube never told me. At ₹249 a month that is nothing for us, so I will keep it for the year if the re-test shows the gaps closing.
objection: More screen time is the last thing my child needs, and I already use ChatGPT with her for free, so I am not sure this adds much beyond the school telling her to do it.
would_change_my_mind: If the end-of-term re-test shows no real improvement, or the teacher stops actually checking it in class, I would cancel and go back to ChatGPT and a tutor.
